'''Ember Squad''' was a military unit in the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]]. During the [[Galactic War]] they were assigned to protect the [[Republic Tarisian Archival Database]] on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]].<ref name="The Fathers of Taris">{{TORcite|type=heroic|The Fathers of Taris|[[Taris/Legends|Taris]]}}</ref>
